rationale: unit:given.classes supplies C and f and unit:given.syntax supplies x, e and the original statements. This unit introduces binding pattern b before its grammar. Pattern has only variable name and unpack className (List (FieldName × VariableId)); the new Statement pairs Pattern with the unchanged Value type, and its Configuration uses a list of those statements. Hence patterns are flat, including the empty list, with no wildcard/rest or recursive-pattern form. Bind/Transfer in the packet's Unpacking context enforce the stated distinct fields/destinations and exhaustive transfer while permitting selection in arbitrary pattern order. Their implementation removes the container, unlike a field Take in the base Step context. The f shorthand is an authored notation for the explicit (f,f) pair; it is not asserted to be a separate Lean syntax constructor. Prior results are explicitly scoped to the original variable-binding fragment.
limitations: This is a correspondence comparison of the frozen prose, exact selected statements/definitions, and identified semantic context. No Lean build, test execution, or proof-tactic audit was performed; compilation and evidence validation are separate checks.

Listed full-source context snapshots were consulted for the supporting declarations and example states discussed in the rationale and dependency comparisons; the listing does not claim examination of every unrelated proof or declaration in those files.
